<a id="EcmaScript"></a>

### ECMAScript

`EcmaScript` · `src/ecmascript.ts:14`

What the language fixes itself, and code uses: where a list starts, how an integer comes back to 32 bits.

Source: ECMA-262, ECMAScript 2024: § 23.1 Array (indices, indexOf), § 13.9.3 unsigned right shift (ToUint32) · `https://tc39.es/ecma262/2024/`

| Constant | Value | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `firstIndex` | `0` | The index of the first item of a list, of the first character of a text |
| `notFound` | `-1` | What indexOf returns when the value is not in the list (§ 23.1.3.17) |
| `toUnsigned32` | `0` | x >>> 0: a zero, unsigned shift; brings x back to 32 unsigned bits |

### ECMAScript types

`EcmaScriptTypes` · `src/ecmascript.ts:30`

What typeof says of a value (ECMA-262 2024, § 13.5.3, Table 41): the names a body compares to know what it holds.

Source: ECMA-262, ECMAScript 2024: § 13.5.3 The typeof operator (Table 41) · `https://tc39.es/ecma262/2024/#sec-typeof-operator`

| Constant | Value | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `undefined` | `undefined` | What typeof says of undefined |
| `object` | `object` | What typeof says of an object that is not a function, and of null |
| `boolean` | `boolean` | What typeof says of true and false |
| `number` | `number` | What typeof says of a number, NaN and the infinities included |
| `string` | `string` | What typeof says of a text |
| `symbol` | `symbol` | What typeof says of a symbol |
| `bigint` | `bigint` | What typeof says of a big integer |
| `function` | `function` | What typeof says of an object that can be called |

<a id="UnicodeEscape"></a>

### Unicode escape of a text

`UnicodeEscape` · `src/ecmascript.ts:128`

A character a text shows only as an escape: a backslash, u, and four hexadecimal digits (ECMA-262, UnicodeEscapeSequence; JSON writes the same).

Source: ECMA-262 2024, § 12.9.4 String Literals (UnicodeEscapeSequence :: u Hex4Digits); RFC 8259 § 7 · `https://tc39.es/ecma262/2024/#prod-UnicodeEscapeSequence`

| Constant | Value | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `prefix` | `\u` | Opens the escape: a backslash and u |
| `radix` | `16` | Its digits are hexadecimal |
| `digits` | `4` | Four of them: the code unit, padded on the left |
| `pad` | `0` | What pads the digits on the left |

<a id="TextAsCode"></a>

### Text run as code

`TextAsCode` · `src/ecmascript.ts:113`

What makes code of a text while a program runs, in ECMA-262 2024: the global function eval (§ 19.2.1), the Function constructor (§ 20.2.1.1), and the property that leads from any value to its constructor, and so to Function's (§ 20.1.3.1, Object.prototype.constructor). Code made of a text escapes every check made on the code as written.

| Word | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `eval` | Runs a text as code (§ 19.2.1) |
| `Function` | Makes a function of a text (§ 20.2.1.1) |
| `constructor` | Leads from any value to its constructor, Function's among them (§ 20.1.3.1) |
